design: prior-averaged local delta-method predictive variance; same available information
failure_policy: retain all finite last iterates even if max_nfev is reached and flag optimizer_success=false; exceptions or nonfinite predictions fall back to nominal prior mean and are flagged
followup_origin: secondary hypothesis suggested by first frozen study; independently generated new networks

forecast_primary.contrast: ensemble risk forecast score - nominal risk forecast score

forecast_secondary: matched/bias_shift and local_vector; exploratory95; no equivalence claim
independent_unit: connection matrix J; other repeats nested
normalized_missing_policy: primary raw risk retains every target; complete standardized stratum is NA if any prescribed target has prior variance <= frozen floor; valid-target display exploratory only
primary_interval: risk forecast hypothesis specified separately: one 95% J-cluster interval
primary_metric: mean squared raw q error aggregated within J over truth/noise/target/design repeats
secondary_comparisons: all other strata and 2x2 interaction exploratory 95% network-cluster intervals
secondary_metric: mean error^2 divided by common independent nonlinear prior-MC q variance
source_scope: independent synthetic simulations; no biological validation or new-method claim
vector_target: same three prespecified readouts; equal raw-response weights
